lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters arranged in a semi-regular grid; spatial density is highest posterior to the gill slits with smaller blob diameters, transitioning to larger, more sparsely distributed nodes as they progress towards the posterior flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect horizontal blob sequences; primary blobs are positioned as anchor nodes within these vertical stripes, forming a grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, marked by a sharp vertical intensity gradient consisting of high-luminance upper edges and shadowed lower edges.
